notes: NSE is the primary exchange-data layer for public interfaces used by this project.
Streamlit local storage is cache only; durable historical data are mirrored to Google Drive.
GitHub stores code and small model release artifacts, not historical datasets or secrets.
NSE public web endpoints can rate-limit or change; the client fails explicitly rather than silently substituting another provider.
Public NSE quote-chart intraday data is treated as LTP-based 1-minute data; missing volume is not fabricated.
